question: What decision currently governs elasticsearch multi value enforcement after the revert record mentions future work? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: The currently active decision governing multi-value enforcement is elastic/elasticsearch#147360, which reverts the enforcement of single values when multi_value is configured as 'no'.
The authority evidence for this active revert decision is documented at https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/147360, which was executed to unblock CI after test failures.
Prior decision elastic/elasticsearch#147071 previously enforced single values for fields with multi_value=no, but it is no longer active due to being reverted by elastic/elasticsearch#147360.
